title: Virtual Compute: agg multi holding
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract. Multiple independent resource scopes may be held. Use external reference as the signed resource-scope key. Count all nonclosed holdings of this category for the same customer; refuse creation if the count would exceed maximum nonclosed contracts per customer. A repeated signed application with the same external resource scope reuses the existing contract rather than opening another.

## Evidence — scope unique

For open, The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using compute contract reference, customer reference, status, external reference. Those records correlate to the current action by compute contract reference, customer reference.

## Policy parameter — maximum nonclosed contracts per customer

maximum nonclosed contracts per customer: 24.
